name: 2-Dimethylamino-2-methyl-1-propanol
description: 2-Dimethylamino-2-methyl-1-propanol (CAS 7005-47-2 ), commonly abbreviated as DMAMP, is an amino alcohol used across industrial and personal care formulations as a pH regulator, neutralizing agent, and corrosion inhibitor. Its combination of amine and hydroxyl functionality makes it effective at adjusting alkalinity in aqueous systems while supporting emulsion stability. In coatings and adhesives, it neutralizes acidic latex emulsions and waterborne resins. This process improves dispersion stability and shelf life for various industrial products. Personal care formulators use it to adjust pH in creams, lotions, and hair care products where amine-based neutralizers are preferred. These organic neutralizers are often chosen over inorganic bases for better compatibility. Water treatment applications rely on its corrosion inhibition properties in cooling water and boiler systems to protect metal surfaces. In printing inks and paper coatings, it functions as a neutralizer for acrylic binders, controlling rheology and adhesion to substrate. This ensures consistent performance across different printing and coating environments. The chemical is supplied as a clear liquid, typically at concentrations of 95% and above. Technical grade is the standard offering for industrial coatings, water treatment, and printing applications requiring high efficiency. Cosmetic-grade material meeting relevant purity specifications is available for personal care end uses. This ensures that the product meets the necessary safety and quality requirements for topical applications and consumer goods.
